verdict.rationale: Zero's founder describes it as an AI-powered email client where users can chat with their inbox, ask questions about threads, and have AI draft replies, and the MCP docs confirm natural-language driven actions (compose, search, ask questions, web search) — this directly matches AI-native NL command operation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the actual chat UI/NL command interface beyond founder claims and MCP protocol docs.
